subheadings.rawText: Professional with a passion for technology and innovation. Experienced in building scalable cloud solutions, developing embedded systems, and optimizing machine learning algorithms. Strong problem-solving and communication skills with a proven track record of delivering high-impact projects. Looking to leverage my expertise in cloud architecture and data engineering to drive business growth and innovation.

resumeItems: Built a MongoDB aggregation pipeline for data processing, achieving \textbf{80% reduction in latency and 100% booking conflict detection}.
Rebuilt \textbf{Angular/TypeScript} frontend and \textbf{Node.js} backend, improving page load times by //textbf{45%} and increasing user engagement by \textbf{30%}.
Implemented a dynamic tenant visualization system with role-based access controls, eliminating tenant confusions and ensuring robust privacy and security standards.
Leading Angular upgrade from version 7 to 21, implementing unit tests with \textbf{Jest} and maintaining \textbf{CI/CD} pipeline for zero-downtime deployments.
Developing AI-powered tenant matching system by analyzing lifestyle preferences and compatibility scores of users.

Researched and developed a facial recognition & labeling system for historical military photographs using \textbf{OpenCV}, and \textbf{DeepFace} achieving \textbf{100% accuracy} for portraits and small groups.
Built a full-stack application using \textbf{React} with \textbf{PHP} backend, and \textbf{Python facial recognition pipeline} for image processing, data retrieval & management.
\textbf{Languages}: Python, JavaScript, Java, C#, PHP, SQL, TypeScript.
\textbf{Frameworks}: React/React Native, Node.js, .NET, FastAPI, REST API.
\textbf{Database}: MySQL, PostgreSQL, MS SQL Server, MongoDB, Redis.
\textbf{QA & Automation}: MyJest, JUnit, Postman, Selenium, Katalon Studio, Playwright.
\textbf{Tools and Platforms}: AWS (S3, EC2, Lambda), Git, Docker, Jira, Confluence, Bitbucket.
Developed a traffic monitoring system using computer vision algorithms in Python, achieving \textbf{95%} accuracy in vehicle detection.
Deployed the system on AWS with Lambda and S3 for scalable image processing, reducing processing costs by \textbf{40%}.
Created a mobile application in React Native for tracking personal finances, with secure data storage using Firebase Authentication and Firestore.
Integrated data visualization features to provide users with monthly spending insights, improving financial literacy for over 500 users.
Relevant coursework: Data Structures and Algorithms, Client and Server side Programming, Android Development, iOS Programming, Parallel Processing
